title: Fix Tauri required route contract drift
summary: Add the backend startup reconciliation dry-run route to the Tauri required-route list so the shell contract matches the Python Local API contract.
reason: The broader Tauri scaffold suite failed because POST /api/startup/reconcile-dry-run exists in the Python command contract but was missing from the Tauri route audit list.
behavior_before: Tauri route-contract validation reported drift for POST /api/startup/reconcile-dry-run even though the backend contract already exposed the route.
behavior_after: Tauri route-contract validation includes POST /api/startup/reconcile-dry-run with the same authenticated POST shape as the Python backend contract.
manual_validation: git diff --check targeted Tauri route contract files - passed
npm run check in apps/desktop/tauri - passed
pytest Tauri scaffold plus private beta release/productization suite - passed (99 passed)
refresh_summaries targeted Tauri route contract paths - passed
rollback_plan: Remove the route entry from apps/desktop/tauri/src-tauri/src/backend_contract/routes.rs and this change packet.
notes: This only updates a Tauri route audit constant. It does not expose a new backend route, alter repair/reconcile behavior, or add frontend mutation authority.
